kpis.description: The 2024 annual IVR congress took place from May 15-17 in Frankfurt with 225 participants representing members and partners in the inland shipping sector. This major event included workshops, debates on sustainability and regulatory framework.

kpis.name: Loss Prevention Colloquium Participants
kpis.explanation: Number of participants at the inaugural loss prevention colloquium organized by IVR in November 2024.
kpis.description: The inaugural IVR loss prevention colloquium took place on November 4, 2024 in Antwerp with approximately 80 participants. Eight presentations covered technical and financial topics related to loss prevention in European inland shipping.
kpis.signal: Approximately 80 participants from Belgium, Netherlands and Germany at the inaugural November 2024 colloquium in Antwerp.
